original_caption: A light blue denim jacket with long sleeves, button closures down the front, and two chest pockets. The jacket features a classic pointed collar and straight hem.
edit_instruction: Convert to a sleeveless style by cutting off sleeves at shoulder seams, keeping original buttons and pocket design.
resulting_caption: A light blue denim sleeveless jacket with button closures down the front, two chest pockets, and a classic pointed collar.

original_caption: An olive green military-style vest with long sleeves that end in wide cuffs. It has five evenly spaced buttons along the front opening.
edit_instruction: Remove sleeves entirely to create a sleeveless vest while retaining all other features including button closure and cuff design at arm holes.
resulting_caption: An olive green military-style sleeveless vest with five evenly spaced buttons along the front opening.

original_caption: A black cotton tank top featuring spaghetti straps that cross in an X pattern over the back, creating a low scoop neck front and a deep plunge neckline at the back.
edit_instruction: Widen the straps to form a halter style without altering the crossover design or depth of necklines.
resulting_caption: A black cotton halter top featuring spaghetti straps that cross in an X pattern over the back, creating a low scoop neck front and a deep plunge neckline at the back.

original_caption: A white silk blouse with short sleeves, a stand-up collar, and delicate pintucking along the bodice. The blouse has a single button closure at the throat.
edit_instruction: Shorten hemline to crop length while preserving sleeve style, neckline design, and pintucked detail.
resulting_caption: A cropped white silk blouse with short sleeves, a stand-up collar, delicate pintucking along the bodice, and a single button closure at the throat.

original_caption: A floral-patterned chiffon dress with long sheer sleeves. The dress features ruffles around the neckline and hemline, creating an elegant flow.
edit_instruction: Cut off sleeves to create a short-sleeved look while retaining the original floral pattern and ruffled details at neckline and hem.
resulting_caption: A floral-patterned chiffon top with short sheer sleeves. The top features ruffles around the neckline and hemline, creating an elegant flow.

original_caption: An off-white crew neck sweater in a cable knit pattern with ribbed cuffs at the wrist and bottom hem.

resulting_caption: A sleeveless off-white cable knit sweater with a crew neck, featuring ribbed trims around the neck and hem.

original_caption: A black turtleneck bodysuit made of stretchy fabric. It has short sleeves, snap closures at crotch for easy dressing.

original_caption: A yellow cotton blouse featuring short puff sleeves, gathered shoulders, and button-down front closure. It has two small pockets on either side.
edit_instruction: Remove puffed portions from sleeves to create regular fitted sleeves while keeping rest of features intact.
resulting_caption: A yellow cotton blouse with short fitted sleeves, gathered shoulders, button-down front closure, and two small pockets on either side.

original_caption: A burgundy velveteen blazer featuring notch lapels, single-breasted style, long sleeves ending in cuff buttons. It has a two-button front.
